tokens.faq_1_question: What should I do if my garage door spring breaks while my car is inside?
tokens.faq_1_answer: Do not attempt to force the door open manually or run the automatic opener, as this can destroy the motor and cables. Call our 24/7 emergency dispatch to safely release and lift the door.
tokens.faq_2_question: Why do torsion springs break with a loud bang?
tokens.faq_2_answer: Torsion springs operate under extreme tension to counterbalance hundreds of pounds of door weight. When metal fatigue causes them to snap, the stored tension releases rapidly with a loud pop.
tokens.faq_3_question: Do you charge extra for emergency, weekend, or holiday garage repairs?
tokens.faq_3_answer: We offer transparent, flat-rate emergency pricing with no hidden surprise fees, no matter what time of day or night you call.
tokens.faq_4_question: How fast can your technician arrive to free my car?
tokens.faq_4_answer: Our average emergency on-site arrival time across the service area is between 25 and 40 minutes.
tokens.faq_5_question: Are your garage door technicians licensed and insured?
tokens.faq_5_answer: Every technician on our team is fully licensed, insured, background-checked, and certified in high-tension spring safety.
